name: AD-4 Battledroid Centurion
description: The AD-4 Battledroid Centurion was a type of battle droid used as security forces by the Selkath species on the planet Manaan during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. A number of AD-4 Centurions were among the security forces of Genetics Laboratory G-1, a genetic research facility on Manaan.
